profile.headline: Sr Advanced Software Engineer | Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering | Kubernetes & Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment Guru | I Reduced Online Response Times by 70%
profile.summary:
Below is a single-piece “About” section crafted to fit well under LinkedIn’s 2,600-character limit while maintaining a detailed, opinionated tone. Feel free to adjust the wording or add specific accomplishments to make it your own.

---

**About Me**  
I’m an Engineer who thrives at the intersection of development and operations. From writing clean .NET and Java code to orchestrating containers in Kubernetes, I’ve always believed that robust, automated systems shouldn’t be an afterthought—they should be baked into every stage of software delivery.

I’m a big proponent of “Automation First.” If something is repetitive, it’s a perfect candidate for a script, pipeline, or container. That mindset led me to mastering tools like Terraform for Infrastructure as Code, Helm for application packaging, and various CI/CD platforms that streamline the path from commit to production. My goal is to reduce toil wherever possible, so that teams can focus on innovation rather than firefighting.

Reliability, in my view, is an ongoing pursuit rather than a box you tick off. That’s why I pay close attention to monitoring, logging, and metrics—these are the signals that help me catch issues early and guide better architecture decisions. Whether I’m establishing robust deployment pipelines, setting up alerts that prevent minor hiccups from turning into major incidents, or tuning a microservice for performance, I’m constantly seeking new ways to raise the bar for resiliency.

But SRE isn’t just about tools or technology; it’s also about culture. The best solutions emerge when Dev, Ops, QA, and Product teams unite around a shared mission of delivering value while minimizing downtime. I’m a firm believer in open communication, post-mortems without blame, and continuous learning. After all, when everyone shares responsibility, we all share in the success.

If you share my passion for building reliable, automated systems and enjoy geeking out over DevOps best practices, let’s connect! I’m always eager to collaborate with forward-thinking professionals who want to push the boundaries of what modern infrastructure can achieve.

positions.title: Sr Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
My Role
My work as an SRE focuses on balancing rapid feature delivery with maintaining stable, resilient environments. By embracing DevOps principles, I partner with development, QA, security, and product teams to ensure rigorous automated testing, streamlined packaging, and reliable deployments—all while minimizing downtime.

A core tenet I champion is Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Using Terraform and similar tools, I place infrastructure changes under version control, reducing drift and simplifying rollbacks or environment replication. Combined with well-structured Helm charts and containerization, this approach fosters a predictable, reproducible release pipeline—one that avoids the classic “it works on my machine” pitfalls.

Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure as Code
Define, maintain, and scale production environments using Terraform for reproducible, version-controlled deployments.

CI/CD Pipeline Mastery
Architect and refine pipelines with tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions for automated builds, testing, and seamless releases.

Container Orchestration
Leverage Kubernetes and Helm to run containerized workloads, streamline deployments, and facilitate reliable rollbacks when needed.

Monitoring & Observability
Implement logging, metrics, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) to detect performance bottlenecks early and maintain robust SLIs and SLOs.

Polyglot Development
Collaborate with teams coding in .NET and Java, reviewing pull requests and advising on best practices, performance, and reliability.

Incident Response & Post-Mortems
Triage production incidents, coordinate quick fixes, and lead post-mortem sessions that strengthen overall system resilience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with developers, QA, and product owners to foster a DevOps culture of communication, shared responsibility, and continuous improvement.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
I integrate cloud solutions and media technologies in the IoT landscape to enhance the comfort, security, and efficiency of homes and buildings. I lead the development and implementation of cloud and media integration solutions, notably engineering Resideo’s in-house media solution, which shifted camera services from external vendors to internal control, streamlining operations.
•	Cloud Solutions Integration: Specialized in integrating cloud solutions within the IoT landscape, enhancing the comfort, security, and efficiency of homes and buildings.
•	Project Leadership: Led the development and implementation of innovative cloud and media integration solutions, including a comprehensive media solution for Resideo that transitioned camera services from external vendors to in-house management.
•	Operational Efficiency: Engineered solutions that streamlined operations and enhanced product control, significantly reducing dependency on external sources.
•	Infrastructure Automation: Utilized Ansible and Terraform to implement automation solutions that reduced manual overhead and increased system consistency; developed scripts for automating the deployment of new certificates across all environments.
•	CI/CD Processes: Instituted CI/CD methodologies to enhance development workflows and accelerate release cycles, improving product deployment efficiency and system reliability.
•	Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Integration: Pioneered the integration of AKS at Resideo, leading cloud infrastructure transitions and optimizations that enhanced application deployment and management.
•	Cloud Architecture Design: Designed and orchestrated a major architectural overhaul of cloud services, adopting modern technologies and best practices to foster innovation and improve service delivery.
•	Security and Compliance: Enhanced system security and ensured compliance by enabling the Operations team to deploy new certificates with zero downtime across multiple environments.
